name: Bunstation
description: Build websites and apps from a prompt, edit files, publish, manage Cloud endpoints, crons, and Postgres, and check credits and usage.
author: Bunstation

tools.name: projects_create
tools.description: Create one Bunstation project from a prompt and start building it. stack is vite or nextjs. model is an OpenRouter model id. Defaults: vite and openai/gpt-5.6-luna. requested_count is how many projects the user asked for in this message. Pass the real number. If it is greater than 3, this tool creates nothing. Do not call this tool when the user asked for more than 3 projects. Tell them the maximum is 3 at a time.

prompt.description: Natural-language description of the website to build.

requested_count.description: Total number of projects requested in the current user message.

stack.description: Frontend stack to use; defaults to vite.

model.description: OpenRouter model ID used for generation; defaults to openai/gpt-5.6-luna.

tools.name: templates_list
tools.description: List public templates from the Bunstation app library, newest first. Same projects as the templates page. Optional category filters that list, for example restaurant or landing_page.

category.description: Optional template category slug, such as restaurant or landing_page.

tools.name: templates_use
tools.description: Copy a public template into a new project owned by the authenticated user. This is the app remix: the template repository is copied, and no prompt build starts. Pass template_id from templates_list.

template_id.description: UUID of a public template returned by templates_list.

tools.name: projects_list
tools.description: List the authenticated user's Bunstation projects, newest activity first.

tools.name: projects_get
tools.description: Get one project the authenticated user owns.

project_id.description: UUID of a Bunstation project owned by the authenticated user.

tools.name: projects_files_list
tools.description: List file paths in a project, including uncommitted creates and deletes.

project_id.description: UUID of a Bunstation project owned by the authenticated user.

tools.name: projects_files_read
tools.description: Read a text file, including an uncommitted change when one exists.

project_id.description: UUID of a Bunstation project owned by the authenticated user.

path.description: Path of the text file to read.

tools.name: projects_files_search
tools.description: Search text in a project, including uncommitted changes. Uses the live preview when it is running, otherwise the committed repository.

project_id.description: UUID of a Bunstation project owned by the authenticated user.

query.description: Literal text to search for in project files.

case_sensitive.description: Whether letter casing must match; defaults to false.

whole_word.description: Whether to match only complete words; defaults to false.

max_results.description: Maximum number of matches to return; defaults to 40.

tools.name: projects_files_create
tools.description: Stage a new text file. It stays uncommitted until projects_changes_commit. Path is relative to the project root.

project_id.description: UUID of a Bunstation project owned by the authenticated user.

path.description: Path for the new text file.

content.description: Complete UTF-8 text content for the new file.

tools.name: projects_files_update
tools.description: Stage a full replacement of an existing text file. It stays uncommitted until projects_changes_commit.

project_id.description: UUID of a Bunstation project owned by the authenticated user.

path.description: Path of the existing text file to replace.

content.description: Complete replacement UTF-8 text content for the file.

tools.name: projects_files_delete
tools.description: Stage deletion of a file. It stays uncommitted until projects_changes_commit.

project_id.description: UUID of a Bunstation project owned by the authenticated user.

path.description: Path of the existing file to stage for deletion.

tools.name: projects_media_list
tools.description: List files in a project's media library, newest first. These are uploaded assets, not source files. mime_type is inferred from the file name. used_bytes is the user's media usage across all projects.

project_id.description: UUID of a Bunstation project owned by the authenticated user.

tools.name: projects_media_read
tools.description: Preview one file from the project media library. Images up to 4 MB are returned as an image the model can see. Text files up to 4 MB include their contents. Larger files return the public URL only.

project_id.description: UUID of a Bunstation project owned by the authenticated user.

media_id.description: UUID of a media file from projects_media_list.

tools.name: projects_media_upload
tools.description: Prepare an upload into the project media library. This does not accept file bytes. It returns a one-time curl command for POST /projects/:id/media. Run that command in the shell and replace __FILE__ with the local file path. The curl response contains the public URL. Do not base64-encode the file and do not put file contents in this tool. One token allows one request; add more -F media=@path arguments to upload several files together. If the upload fails, call this tool again. The token expires in 10 minutes.

project_id.description: UUID of a Bunstation project owned by the authenticated user.

tools.name: projects_changes_list
tools.description: List uncommitted file changes for a project.

project_id.description: UUID of a Bunstation project owned by the authenticated user.

tools.name: projects_changes_commit
tools.description: Commit every pending file change in a project. Call this after editing files.

project_id.description: UUID of a Bunstation project owned by the authenticated user.

message.description: Optional Git commit message; defaults to Update files.

tools.name: projects_changes_discard
tools.description: Drop one uncommitted file change and keep the committed file.

project_id.description: UUID of a Bunstation project owned by the authenticated user.

path.description: Path whose staged change should be discarded.

tools.name: projects_chat_get
tools.description: Read the recent conversation for a project, whether generation is running, and any queued follow-ups.

project_id.description: UUID of a Bunstation project owned by the authenticated user.

tools.name: projects_generation_stop
tools.description: Stop the generation currently running on a project.

project_id.description: UUID of a Bunstation project owned by the authenticated user.

tools.name: projects_builds_list
tools.description: List recent builds for a project, newest first.

project_id.description: UUID of a Bunstation project owned by the authenticated user.

tools.name: projects_builds_log
tools.description: Read the build log for a commit. Defaults to the latest commit.

project_id.description: UUID of a Bunstation project owned by the authenticated user.

commit_id.description: Optional build commit UUID; when omitted, the latest commit is used.

tools.name: projects_update
tools.description: Rename a project or change the model used for later messages.

project_id.description: UUID of a Bunstation project owned by the authenticated user.

name.description: New display name for the project.

model.description: New OpenRouter model ID for later project generations.

tools.name: projects_publish
tools.description: Publish a successful build on a bunstation.app subdomain. Defaults to the latest successful commit and the project id as the subdomain.

project_id.description: UUID of a Bunstation project owned by the authenticated user.

commit_id.description: Optional successful build commit UUID; defaults to the latest successful build.

subdomain.description: Optional DNS label for the published site; defaults to the project UUID.

tools.name: projects_cloud_get
tools.description: Read Bunstation Cloud for a project: Postgres, Auth, HTTP endpoints, and cron jobs. database.url, auth.service_role_key, and auth.jwt_secret are secrets. Do not write them into public website source. Login and signup use projectUrl/auth/v1 with the anon key. Custom HTTP uses publicHost.

project_id.description: UUID of a Bunstation project owned by the authenticated user.

tools.name: projects_cloud_enable
tools.description: Turn on Bunstation Cloud for a project. Creates Postgres and Auth when they do not exist, or starts a stopped Cloud backend. Returns the same status as projects_cloud_get, plus created.

project_id.description: UUID of a Bunstation project owned by the authenticated user.

tools.name: projects_cloud_stop
tools.description: Pause Bunstation Cloud for a project. Postgres, endpoints, and crons stop. Data and code stay in place.

project_id.description: UUID of a Bunstation project owned by the authenticated user.

tools.name: projects_cloud_endpoint_get
tools.description: Read one HTTP endpoint, including its TypeScript source. Use the id from projects_cloud_get.

project_id.description: UUID of a Bunstation project owned by the authenticated user.

tools.name: projects_cloud_endpoint_create
tools.description: Create one HTTP endpoint: one method, one path, and one Hono route. Do not create login, signup, or /auth routes. Auth already exists at projectUrl/auth/v1. Call this once per route. Platform CORS allows browser fetch from any domain.

project_id.description: UUID of a Bunstation project owned by the authenticated user.

path.description: HTTP path starting with /, for example /orders or /orders/:id.

method.description: HTTP method. GET, POST, PUT, or DELETE.

name.description: Optional DNS label, lowercase, max 32 characters.

source.description: TypeScript source exporting a Hono app with exactly one app.get, app.post, app.put, or app.delete.

starter.description: Starter used when source is omitted. Login and signup are not starters. Auth is projectUrl/auth/v1.

env.description: String map. Do not put these values in public website source.

tools.name: projects_cloud_endpoint_update
tools.description: Change an endpoint's source, path, or method. One Hono route only. Do not point it at login, signup, or /auth.

project_id.description: UUID of a Bunstation project owned by the authenticated user.

method.description: HTTP method. GET, POST, PUT, or DELETE.

source.description: Replacement TypeScript source with exactly one Hono route.

tools.name: projects_cloud_cron_get
tools.description: Read one cron job, including its schedule and TypeScript source. Use the id from projects_cloud_get.

project_id.description: UUID of a Bunstation project owned by the authenticated user.

tools.name: projects_cloud_cron_create
tools.description: Create a scheduled job. name is a lowercase DNS label. schedule is a 5-field UTC cron expression, for example */5 * * * *. Source exports default async () => {}. Crons are not called from the website.

project_id.description: UUID of a Bunstation project owned by the authenticated user.

schedule.description: 5-field UTC cron expression, for example */15 * * * * or @daily.

env.description: String map. Do not put these values in public website source.

dependencies.description: String map. Do not put these values in public website source.

tools.name: projects_cloud_cron_update
tools.description: Change a cron's source, schedule, or enabled flag. Pass at least one of those fields.

project_id.description: UUID of a Bunstation project owned by the authenticated user.

enabled.description: Whether the cron runs on its schedule.

tools.name: projects_cloud_cron_run
tools.description: Invoke one cron once now. This does not change its schedule.

project_id.description: UUID of a Bunstation project owned by the authenticated user.

tools.name: projects_cloud_database_tables
tools.description: List Postgres schemas and tables for the project's Cloud database. Cloud must be enabled.

project_id.description: UUID of a Bunstation project owned by the authenticated user.

tools.name: projects_cloud_database_rows
tools.description: Read one page of rows from a Cloud Postgres table. schema defaults to public.

project_id.description: UUID of a Bunstation project owned by the authenticated user.

tools.name: projects_cloud_database_row_insert
tools.description: Insert one row into a Cloud Postgres table. schema defaults to public.

project_id.description: UUID of a Bunstation project owned by the authenticated user.

values.description: Column values for the new row.

tools.name: projects_cloud_database_row_update
tools.description: Update one Cloud Postgres row. identity is the primary key, for example { "id": "..." }.

project_id.description: UUID of a Bunstation project owned by the authenticated user.

identity.description: Primary key of the row to update.

tools.name: projects_cloud_database_rows_delete
tools.description: Delete Cloud Postgres rows by primary key. identities is a list of key objects.

project_id.description: UUID of a Bunstation project owned by the authenticated user.

identities.description: Primary keys of the rows to delete.

tools.name: projects_cloud_database_query
tools.description: Run SQL on the project's Cloud Postgres database. Use this for SELECT and for schema changes such as CREATE TABLE. Results are capped by the database API.

project_id.description: UUID of a Bunstation project owned by the authenticated user.

sql.description: SQL to run on the Cloud Postgres database.

tools.name: projects_cloud_database_schema_create
tools.description: Create a Postgres schema in the project's Cloud database.

project_id.description: UUID of a Bunstation project owned by the authenticated user.

tools.name: account_credits_get
tools.description: Return the authenticated user's credit balance and current subscription plan.

tools.name: account_invoices_list
tools.description: List the authenticated user's invoices, newest first. Amounts are in major currency units.

limit.description: Maximum number of invoices to return; defaults to 20.

tools.name: account_invoices_get
tools.description: Get one invoice and its hosted Stripe URL. Use the id from account_invoices_list.

tools.name: account_usage_get
tools.description: Return token usage for the authenticated user. date_range is this_week, this_month, or all_time. Defaults to this_month. Includes a total and recent log rows.

date_range.description: Usage period to aggregate; defaults to this_month.

page.description: One-based page number for recent usage rows; defaults to 1.

limit.description: Maximum usage rows per page; defaults to 20.
